SELECT
    s.END_DATE AS `报告日期`,
    s.SEC_CSNAME AS `股票简称`,
    s.COMB_SYMBOL AS `股票代码`,
    ROUND(
        (
            COALESCE(s.REVENUE_ASIA_USD,0) +
            COALESCE(s.REVENUE_OCEANIA_USD,0) +
            COALESCE(s.REVENUE_EU_USD,0) +
            COALESCE(s.REVENUE_NON_EU_USD,0) +
            COALESCE(s.REVENUE_AFRICA_USD,0) +
            COALESCE(s.REVENUE_MID_EAST_USD,0) +
            COALESCE(s.REVENUE_LATIN_AMERICA_USD,0) +
            COALESCE(s.REVENUE_NORTH_AMERICA_USD,0) +
            COALESCE(s.REVENUE_JAPAN_USD,0) +
            COALESCE(s.REVENUE_KOREA_USD,0) +
            COALESCE(s.REVENUE_TW_USD,0) +
            COALESCE(s.REVENUE_RUSSIA_USD,0)
        ) / NULLIF(s.REVENUE_ASIA_USD + s.REVENUE_OCEANIA_USD + s.REVENUE_EU_USD + s.REVENUE_NON_EU_USD + s.REVENUE_AFRICA_USD + s.REVENUE_MID_EAST_USD + s.REVENUE_LATIN_AMERICA_USD + s.REVENUE_NORTH_AMERICA_USD + s.REVENUE_AMERICA_USD + s.REVENUE_JAPAN_USD + s.REVENUE_KOREA_USD + s.REVENUE_TW_USD + s.REVENUE_RUSSIA_USD, 0) * 100
    ,2) AS `国外收入占比(%)`,
    COALESCE(s.REVENUE_ASIA_USD,0) AS `亚洲收入(百万美元)`,
    COALESCE(s.REVENUE_OCEANIA_USD,0) AS `大洋洲收入(百万美元)`,
    COALESCE(s.REVENUE_EU_USD,0) AS `欧盟收入(百万美元)`,
    COALESCE(s.REVENUE_NON_EU_USD,0) AS `非欧盟收入(百万美元)`,
    COALESCE(s.REVENUE_AFRICA_USD,0) AS `非洲收入(百万美元)`,
    COALESCE(s.REVENUE_MID_EAST_USD,0) AS `中东收入(百万美元)`,
    COALESCE(s.REVENUE_LATIN_AMERICA_USD,0) AS `拉美收入(百万美元)`,
    COALESCE(s.REVENUE_NORTH_AMERICA_USD,0) AS `北美收入(百万美元)`,
    COALESCE(s.REVENUE_AMERICA_USD,0) AS `美国收入(百万美元)`,
    COALESCE(s.REVENUE_JAPAN_USD,0) AS `日本收入(百万美元)`,
    COALESCE(s.REVENUE_KOREA_USD,0) AS `韩国收入(百万美元)`,
    COALESCE(s.REVENUE_TW_USD,0) AS `中国台湾收入(百万美元)`,
    COALESCE(s.REVENUE_RUSSIA_USD,0) AS `俄罗斯收入(百万美元)`
FROM
    ASTK_REVENUE_OVERSEAS s
WHERE
    s.END_DATE >= '2025-01-01'
    AND s.END_DATE <= '2025-12-31'
    AND s.HISVALID = 1
    AND s.SEC_CSNAME IS NOT NULL
    AND s.COMB_SYMBOL IS NOT NULL
